description: Canonical pattern-mapper input: a small synthetic codebase with 3 modules following a clear handler+service+repository pattern. Expected output: PATTERNS.md identifying the layered pattern, naming conventions, and idioms used. Schema-conformance baseline — Phase 6 trim consumer.
prompt: Spawn the gsd-pattern-mapper agent against the sandbox cwd. Scan src/ (3 files: handler.js, service.js, repository.js) and produce PATTERNS.md describing the patterns observed: layering, naming conventions, dependency direction. Output the full PATTERNS.md.
